package example

import "testing"

func TestBehavior(t *testing.T) {
	c := &Client{}
	value, err := c.Create(3)
	if value != 4 || err != nil || c.Calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("changed result: %d %v %+v", value, err, c)
	}
	value, err = c.Create(-1)
	if value != -1 || err == nil || c.Calls != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("changed early return: %d %v %+v", value, err, c)
	}
}
